intro.heading: Meet Our Research Team
intro.description: Our multidisciplinary research team investigates atmospheric chemistry, air quality, climate processes, and environmental sustainability. Through collaborative research and scientific innovation, we seek to improve understanding of atmospheric processes and their impacts on the environment and society.

staff.name: Prof. Madya Dr. Liew Ju Neng
staff.role: Associate Professor, Department of Earth Sciences and Environment
staff.description: Focuses on climate and ocean modelling, climate-change projections, regional downscaling, and numerical weather prediction.

staff.name: Prof. Dr. Mohd Shahrul Mohd Nadzir
staff.role: Associate Professor, Department of Earth Sciences and Environment
staff.description: Studies atmospheric chemistry and the composition of atmospheric aerosols, including halocarbons and their environmental behaviour.

staff.name: Ts. Dr. Murnira Othman
staff.role: Research Fellow, Institute of Environment and Development (LESTARI)
staff.description: Researches indoor air pollution, atmospheric composition, biomass burning, and sensor-based air-quality monitoring, including environmental and human-health implications.

staff.name: Dr. Norfazrin Mohd Hanif
staff.role: Senior Lecturer, Department of Earth Sciences and Environment
staff.description: Studies atmospheric chemistry, trace-gas emissions and transport, regional air quality, and atmospheric pollutants.

staff.name: Dr. Ooi Chel Gee (Maggie)
staff.role: Research Fellow, Institute of Climate Change
staff.description: Focuses on chemical weather prediction, atmospheric modelling, biomass-burning emissions, and the transport of air pollutants.

staff.name: Dr. Haris Hafizal Abd Hamid
staff.role: Science Officer, Faculty of Science and Technology
staff.description: Researches volatile and semi-volatile organic compounds in ambient air, contributing to the understanding and assessment of atmospheric pollution.

staff.name: Dr. Muhammad Ikram Abdul Wahab
staff.description: Works in toxicology and environmental health, with a focus on understanding the effects of chemical substances on living organisms.

staff.name: Prof. Dr. Ahmad Fariz Mohamed
staff.description: Focuses on environmental sustainability, waste management, and urban liveability, connecting environmental research with sustainable urban development.

postgraduates.name: Nur Nadrah Mohd Naim
postgraduates.researchTitle: Fine Particulate Matter in School Environment: Characterization, Source Apportionment and Health Risk Assessment
postgraduates.description: Investigates fine particulate matter in school environments, focusing on chemical characterisation, source apportionment and health-risk assessment.

postgraduates.name: Muhsin Otuyol
postgraduates.researchTitle: Study of the Indoor Air Quality (IAQ), Thermal Comfort and Energy Efficiency in Vehicle
postgraduates.supervisor: Main supervisor: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Mohd Shahrul Mohd Nadzir
postgraduates.description: Examines in-vehicle indoor air quality, thermal comfort and energy use to support healthier and more efficient vehicle environments.

postgraduates.name: Najihah Nazima Ghani
postgraduates.researchTitle: Indoor air quality in car and its effect to human health
postgraduates.description: Assesses in-vehicle air quality and its potential implications for human health.

postgraduates.name: Hartini Mahidin
postgraduates.researchTitle: The Impact of Land-Use Changes on Biogenic Isoprene Emissions and Surface Ozone Concentration in Malaysian Borneo
postgraduates.supervisor: Co-supervisors: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Liew Ju Neng and Dr. Ooi Chel Gee (Maggie)
postgraduates.description: Investigates how land-use change influences biogenic isoprene emissions and surface ozone formation in Malaysian Borneo.

postgraduates.name: Sharifah Mazrah Syed Mohamed Zain
postgraduates.researchTitle: Atmospheric Dioxins and Furans in Kuala Lumpur: Levels, Distribution in PM2.5, Source Apportionment and Health Risks
postgraduates.supervisor: Co-supervisors: Dr Md Firoz Khan and Dr. Norfazrin Mohd Hanif
postgraduates.description: Studies atmospheric dioxins and furans in Kuala Lumpur, including their distribution in PM2.5, sources and associated health risks.

postgraduates.name: Nor Syamimi Sufiera Limi Hawari
postgraduates.researchTitle: Variations of VOC concentrations in the different backgrounds in Peninsular Malaysia
postgraduates.supervisor: Co-supervisors: Dr. Murnira Othman and Dr. Norfazrin Mohd Hanif
postgraduates.description: Examines how volatile organic compound concentrations vary across different environmental backgrounds in Peninsular Malaysia.

contact.heading: Contact and Collaboration
contact.description: The group welcomes collaboration with researchers, public agencies and institutions working on atmospheric science, air quality and climate. For research enquiries, postgraduate supervision or partnership opportunities, please contact the group leader.
contact.note: The group is based within the Faculty of Science and Technology at Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia.
